title: RelationshipType
description: Defines a type of relationship allowed between IFS entity objects.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this relationship type.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "RelationshipType" for RelationshipType entities.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this relationship type was last updated.

type.description: Relationship name, such as partnered, governed by, or resides in.

description.description: Meaning and intended use of this relationship type.

sourceTypes.description: Entity type names allowed as sources of relationships of this type.

targetTypes.description: Entity type names allowed as targets of relationships of this type.

symmetric.description: Whether swapping source and target preserves the relationship meaning, such as partnered.

inverseType.description: Inverse relationship name used when source and target are swapped, such as `has-member` for `member-of`. This is a label, not a relationship type ID.
